title: Purification and Identification of Peptides from Oyster (Crassostrea hongkongensis) Protein Enzymatic Hydrolysates and Their Anti-Skin Photoaging Effects on UVB-Irradiated HaCaT Cells.
authors: Peng, Zhilan; Gao, Jialong; Su, Weimin; Cao, Wenhong; Zhu, Guoping; Qin, Xiaoming; Zhang, Chaohua; Qi, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究牡蛎酶解肽的抗皮肤光老化作用，仅涉及肽与NF-kappaB/MMP-1的分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to purify and identify antiphotoaging peptides from oyster (Crassostrea hongkongensis) protein enzymatic hydrolysates (OPEH) and to investigate the possible mechanism underlying its antiphotoaging effect. Multiple methods (Ultrafiltration, G25 Chromatography, RP-HPLC, and LC/MS/MS) had been used for this purpose, and eventually, two peptides, including WNLNP and RKNEVLGK, were identified. Particularly, WNLNP exerted remarkable antiphotoaging effect on the UVB-irradiated HaCaT photoaged cell model in a dose-dependent manner. WNLNP exerted its protective effect mainly through inhibiting ROS production, decreasing MMP-1 expression, but increasing extracellular pro-collagen I content. Furthermore, WNLNP downregulated p38, JNK, ERK, and p65 phosphorylation in the MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and attenuated bax over-expressions but reversed bcl-2 reduction in UVB- irradiated HaCaT cells. The molecular docking analysis showed that WNLNP forms five and seven hydrogen bonds with NF-kappaB (p65) and MMP-1, respectively. This study suggested that a pentapeptide WNLNP isolated from OPEH had great potential to prevent and regulate skin photoaging.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在从牡蛎（Crassostrea hongkongensis）蛋白酶解物（OPEH）中纯化并鉴定抗光老化肽，并探讨其抗光老化作用的可能机制。为此，采用了多种方法（超滤、G25色谱、RP-HPLC和LC/MS/MS），最终鉴定出两种肽，包括WNLNP和RKNEVLGK。特别是，WNLNP在UVB照射的HaCaT光老化细胞模型中，以剂量依赖性方式表现出显著的抗光老化效果。WNLNP主要通过抑制ROS产生、降低MMP-1表达，同时增加细胞外前胶原I含量来发挥其保护作用。此外，WNLNP下调了MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路中p38、JNK、ERK和p65的磷酸化，并减轻了UVB照射HaCaT细胞中bax的过度表达，但逆转了bcl-2的减少。分子对接分析显示，WNLNP分别与NF-kappaB（p65）和MMP-1形成五个和七个氢键。本研究提示，从OPEH中分离出的五肽WNLNP在预防和调节皮肤光老化方面具有巨大潜力。
